$description: Chart colours: categorical, sequential and the chart frame. Imported separately as tokens.chart.css.

root.$description:
─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
tokens.chart.css — the categorical palette for data visualisation.

WHY THIS IS A SEPARATE FILE FROM THE BRAND ACCENT
-------------------------------------------------
A chart's colours do a different job from a brand's colours, so they are
not derived from the mark and they are not the state hues.

  mark (--mark)             identity. One hue. "This is Anthony."
  state (--success/…)       state. RESERVED — never a series colour.
  categorical (this file)   IDENTITY OF A SERIES. Needs 8 hues that a
                            human can tell apart at a glance, including
                            the ~8% of men with a colour-vision
                            deficiency.

Trying to derive eight distinguishable series hues from one amber gives
you eight ambers nobody can separate. Charts genuinely need the range —
the constraint is separability, not restraint.

THESE VALUES ARE VALIDATED, NOT CHOSEN BY EYE
----------------------------------------------
Values are light-dark(<light>, <dark>), one declaration each.
Both modes pass every hard gate of the six-check colour formula:

  lightness band     PASS  (all 8 inside the mode's band)
  chroma floor       PASS  (all 8 >= 0.1)
  CVD separation     PASS  worst adjacent dE 9.1 light / 8.4 dark  (>=8)
  normal-vision      PASS  worst adjacent dE 19.6 light / 19.3 dark (>=15)
  contrast           light: slots 3, 4, 5 sit below 3:1 — see RELIEF below
                     dark:  all 8 clear 3:1

The ORDER is the colourblind-safety mechanism, not decoration. Slots are
assigned in fixed order and NEVER cycled. Re-ordering silently breaks the
adjacent-pair separation the gates above measure. If you change anything
here, re-run the validator on both modes before shipping.

RULES OF USE
------------
- Fixed order, never cycled. A 9th series is not a generated hue: fold it
  into "Other", facet into small multiples, or cut it. (`stats-pie.tsx`
  already does this correctly — top 8 + "Other".)
- Colour follows the ENTITY, never its rank. A filter that changes the
  series count must not repaint the survivors. Map name -> slot once.
- RELIEF: on light mode, slots 3/4/5 fall below 3:1 against the surface.
  That is legal only with visible direct labels or a table view — which
  the donut's centre readout and the legend already provide. Do not use
  those three as the ONLY signal for a mark with no label.
- Never colour-alone: >=2 series always carries a legend, and <=4 are also
  direct-labelled.
- Text wears text tokens (--ink / --ink-soft / --slate), never the series
  colour. A coloured mark beside a label carries the identity.
─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

chart-other.$description:
Everything past slot 8 aggregates here. Deliberately neutral: "Other"
is not an entity, so it does not earn a hue.

chart-grid.$description:
Axes, gridlines and the ring behind overlapping marks. Recessive by
design — the data is the ink, the frame is not.

seq-0.$description:
─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
SEQUENTIAL — one hue, light to dark, for CONTINUOUS MAGNITUDE.
Not categorical. Use when the thing being coloured is "how much", not
"which one": the GitHub contribution heatmap, a density map, a calendar.

Rules that differ from the categorical palette above:
  - ONE hue. Never a rainbow — a rainbow implies categories where there
    are only degrees.
  - Lightness must be MONOTONIC. Verified in OKLCH: light L 0.888 ->
    0.487 descending, dark L 0.380 -> 0.808 ascending, every adjacent
    step separated by dL >= 0.107.
  - `--seq-0` is NEUTRAL on purpose. Zero contributions is not a small
    amount of the hue, it is the absence of a value — colouring it a pale
    blue would claim data that isn't there.

The hue is cobalt, the same family as --action. That is intentional: a
magnitude ramp is informational, the same register as a link, and giving
it its own hue would add a meaning the system doesn't need.
─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
